parameters.jsCode:
const approval =
  $('Validate Human Decision').item.json;

const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();

const hashPrefix =
  approval.approval_payload_hash.slice(0, 16);

const requestPayload = {
  rfq_id: approval.rfq_id,
  customer_name: approval.customer_name,
  product_id: approval.product_id,
  requested_quantity:
    approval.requested_quantity,
  spot_material_surcharge_pct:
    approval.spot_material_surcharge_pct,
  requested_delivery_date:
    approval.requested_delivery_date,
  requested_discount_pct:
    approval.requested_discount_pct,
  sales_rep: approval.sales_rep,
  request_channel: approval.request_channel,
  proposed_quote_price_usd:
    approval.proposed_quote_price_usd
};

return {
  json: {
    ...approval,

    quote_id:
      `QUOTE-${hashPrefix}`,

    approval_id:
      `APPROVAL-${hashPrefix}-${approval.human_decision}`,

    decision_id:
      `DECISION-${hashPrefix}-${approval.human_decision}`,

    generation_id:
      `GENERATION-${hashPrefix}-0`,

    event_id:
      `EVENT-${approval.workflow_execution_id}-${approval.human_decision}`,

    request_payload_json:
      JSON.stringify(requestPayload),

    request_status:
      approval.human_decision === 'APPROVED'
        ? 'HUMAN_APPROVED_PENDING_WRITE'
        : 'HUMAN_REJECTED',

    idempotency_status: 'NEW',
    persistence_created_at: createdAt,
    persistence_updated_at: createdAt
  }
};

const r = $json;

const persistencePayload = {
  rfq_id: r.rfq_id,
  quote_id: r.quote_id,
  decision_id: r.decision_id,
  generation_id: r.generation_id,
  approval_id: r.approval_id,
  event_id: r.event_id,

  workflow_execution_id:
    r.workflow_execution_id,
  trace_id: r.trace_id,
  calculation_version:
    r.calculation_version,
  prompt_version:
    r.prompt_version,

  request_payload:
    JSON.parse(r.request_payload_json),
  request_payload_hash:
    r.request_payload_hash,

  material_cost_usd:
    Number(r.material_cost_usd),
  labor_cost_usd:
    Number(r.labor_cost_usd),
  unit_cost_usd:
    Number(r.unit_cost_usd),
  total_cost_usd:
    Number(r.total_cost_usd),

  minimum_cfo_approved_price_usd:
    Number(r.minimum_cfo_approved_price_usd),
  proposed_quote_price_usd:
    Number(r.proposed_quote_price_usd),
  realized_gross_margin_pct:
    Number(r.realized_gross_margin_pct),
  cfo_target_gross_margin_pct:
    Number(r.cfo_target_gross_margin_pct),
  is_margin_compliant:
    Boolean(r.is_margin_compliant),

  decision_code: "HUMAN_APPROVED",
  decision_reason:
    r.human_decision_reason,
  approval_payload_hash:
    r.approval_payload_hash,

  ai_status: r.ai_status,
  ai_model: "mock-no-llm",
  input_classification: "L1",
  customer_explanation:
    r.customer_explanation,
  internal_rationale:
    r.internal_rationale,
  negotiation_options:
    r.negotiation_options,
  exception_reason:
    r.exception_reason,
  loop_count:
    Number(r.loop_count),
  loop_stop_reason:
    r.loop_stop_reason,

  approver_id:
    r.approver_id,
  human_decision:
    r.human_decision,
  human_decision_reason:
    r.human_decision_reason,
  approval_expires_at:
    r.approval_expires_at,
  human_decided_at:
    r.human_decided_at,

  created_at:
    r.persistence_created_at,
  updated_at:
    r.persistence_updated_at
};

const persistencePayloadJson =
  JSON.stringify(persistencePayload);

return {
  json: {
    ...r,
    persistence_bundle_version:
      "phase2-persistence-v1",
    persistence_payload_b64:
      Buffer
        .from(
          persistencePayloadJson,
          "utf8"
        )
        .toString("base64"),
    persistence_payload_size_bytes:
      Buffer.byteLength(
        persistencePayloadJson,
        "utf8"
      )
  }
};

parameters.sqlQuery:
DECLARE p JSON DEFAULT PARSE_JSON(
  SAFE_CONVERT_BYTES_TO_STRING(
    FROM_BASE64(
      '{{ $json.persistence_payload_b64 }}'
    )
  )
);

DECLARE v_rfq_id STRING DEFAULT
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.rfq_id');

BEGIN TRANSACTION;

ASSERT (
  SELECT COUNT(*) = 0
  FROM
    `aeroprecision-data-pipeline.ops_manufacturing.ops_rfq_requests`
  WHERE rfq_id = v_rfq_id
) AS 'DUPLICATE_RFQ_ID';

INSERT INTO
  `aeroprecision-data-pipeline.ops_manufacturing.ops_rfq_requests`
(
  rfq_id,
  request_payload_json,
  payload_hash,
  request_status,
  workflow_execution_id,
  trace_id,
  calculation_version,
  created_at,
  updated_at
)
SELECT
  v_rfq_id,
  JSON_QUERY(p, '$.request_payload'),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.request_payload_hash'),
  'PERSISTED',
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.workflow_execution_id'),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.trace_id'),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.calculation_version'),
  TIMESTAMP(JSON_VALUE(p, '$.created_at')),
  TIMESTAMP(JSON_VALUE(p, '$.updated_at'));

INSERT INTO
  `aeroprecision-data-pipeline.ops_manufacturing.ops_quote_calculations`
(
  quote_id,
  rfq_id,
  calculation_version,
  input_hash,
  material_cost_usd,
  labor_cost_usd,
  unit_cost_usd,
  total_cost_usd,
  minimum_cfo_approved_price_usd,
  proposed_quote_price_usd,
  realized_gross_margin_pct,
  cfo_target_gross_margin_pct,
  is_margin_compliant,
  decision_code,
  calculated_at
)
SELECT
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.quote_id'),
  v_rfq_id,
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.calculation_version'),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.request_payload_hash'),
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(p, '$.material_cost_usd') AS NUMERIC),
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(p, '$.labor_cost_usd') AS NUMERIC),
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(p, '$.unit_cost_usd') AS NUMERIC),
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(p, '$.total_cost_usd') AS NUMERIC),
  CAST(
    JSON_VALUE(
      p,
      '$.minimum_cfo_approved_price_usd'
    ) AS NUMERIC
  ),
  CAST(
    JSON_VALUE(
      p,
      '$.proposed_quote_price_usd'
    ) AS NUMERIC
  ),
  CAST(
    JSON_VALUE(
      p,
      '$.realized_gross_margin_pct'
    ) AS NUMERIC
  ),
  CAST(
    JSON_VALUE(
      p,
      '$.cfo_target_gross_margin_pct'
    ) AS NUMERIC
  ),
  CAST(
    JSON_VALUE(
      p,
      '$.is_margin_compliant'
    ) AS BOOL
  ),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.decision_code'),
  TIMESTAMP(JSON_VALUE(p, '$.created_at'));

INSERT INTO
  `aeroprecision-data-pipeline.ops_manufacturing.ops_quote_decisions`
(
  decision_id,
  rfq_id,
  quote_id,
  decision_code,
  decision_reason,
  decision_hash,
  calculation_version,
  created_at
)
SELECT
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.decision_id'),
  v_rfq_id,
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.quote_id'),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.decision_code'),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.decision_reason'),
  TO_HEX(
    SHA256(
      CONCAT(
        JSON_VALUE(p, '$.approval_payload_hash'),
        '|',
        JSON_VALUE(p, '$.human_decision'),
        '|',
        COALESCE(
          JSON_VALUE(p, '$.human_decision_reason'),
          ''
        )
      )
    )
  ),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.calculation_version'),
  TIMESTAMP(JSON_VALUE(p, '$.created_at'));

INSERT INTO
  `aeroprecision-data-pipeline.ops_manufacturing.ops_ai_generations`
(
  generation_id,
  rfq_id,
  quote_id,
  trace_id,
  prompt_version,
  model,
  input_classification,
  input_hash,
  output_hash,
  output_status,
  loop_attempt,
  token_input,
  token_output,
  cost_usd,
  latency_ms,
  stop_reason,
  created_at
)
SELECT
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.generation_id'),
  v_rfq_id,
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.quote_id'),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.trace_id'),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.prompt_version'),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.ai_model'),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.input_classification'),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.request_payload_hash'),
  TO_HEX(
    SHA256(
      CONCAT(
        COALESCE(
          JSON_VALUE(p, '$.customer_explanation'),
          ''
        ),
        '|',
        COALESCE(
          JSON_VALUE(p, '$.internal_rationale'),
          ''
        ),
        '|',
        COALESCE(
          CAST(
            JSON_QUERY(
              p,
              '$.negotiation_options'
            ) AS STRING
          ),
          '[]'
        )
      )
    )
  ),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.ai_status'),
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(p, '$.loop_count') AS INT64),
  NULL,
  NULL,
  NULL,
  NULL,
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.loop_stop_reason'),
  TIMESTAMP(JSON_VALUE(p, '$.created_at'));

INSERT INTO
  `aeroprecision-data-pipeline.ops_manufacturing.ops_human_approvals`
(
  approval_id,
  rfq_id,
  quote_id,
  payload_hash,
  calculation_version,
  prompt_version,
  approver_id,
  decision,
  reason,
  approval_expires_at,
  decided_at,
  created_at
)
SELECT
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.approval_id'),
  v_rfq_id,
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.quote_id'),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.approval_payload_hash'),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.calculation_version'),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.prompt_version'),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.approver_id'),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.human_decision'),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.human_decision_reason'),
  TIMESTAMP(
    JSON_VALUE(p, '$.approval_expires_at')
  ),
  TIMESTAMP(
    JSON_VALUE(p, '$.human_decided_at')
  ),
  TIMESTAMP(JSON_VALUE(p, '$.created_at'));

INSERT INTO
  `aeroprecision-data-pipeline.ops_manufacturing.ops_workflow_audit_log`
(
  event_id,
  rfq_id,
  quote_id,
  workflow_execution_id,
  trace_id,
  event_type,
  event_status,
  event_hash,
  actor_type,
  actor_id,
  reason,
  created_at
)
SELECT
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.event_id'),
  v_rfq_id,
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.quote_id'),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.workflow_execution_id'),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.trace_id'),
  'HUMAN_APPROVAL_APPROVED',
  'PERSISTED',
  TO_HEX(
    SHA256(
      CONCAT(
        JSON_VALUE(p, '$.approval_payload_hash'),
        '|',
        JSON_VALUE(p, '$.approver_id'),
        '|',
        JSON_VALUE(p, '$.human_decision'),
        '|',
        JSON_VALUE(p, '$.human_decided_at')
      )
    )
  ),
  'HUMAN',
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.approver_id'),
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.human_decision_reason'),
  TIMESTAMP(JSON_VALUE(p, '$.created_at'));

COMMIT TRANSACTION;

SELECT
  v_rfq_id AS rfq_id,
  JSON_VALUE(p, '$.quote_id') AS quote_id,
  'PERSISTED' AS persistence_status,
  6 AS tables_written;
